issues.on_page: Line 39 Debt Service 2,843.00 (Water Fund column, printed under the 'Governmental:' heading)
issues.issue: Printed in the governmental section of Exhibit A but in the Water Fund column; recorded as business-type (Water Fund). Defensible and needed for the Water roll-forward to tie, but the page places it under Governmental. The same applies to detail[22].

This is all of the business-type receipts. It sits only in the utility fund columns, so it is almost certainly utility charges (FY2024 used Utility Charges). The page prints no breakdown, so 'other' is defensible, but the business-type side is 100% other. The same applies to detail[21], detail[25] and detail[28].
